label: ex:molecular-hopf-chain-crossing-energy
title: Crossing energy of an open Hopf chain
html:
Example. Crossing energy of an open Hopf chain

Crossing energy of the chain. The total crossing energy is the sum over N - 1 bonds:

  \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{cross}}(\mathcal{C}_N^{(k)})
  = 
  (N - 1) \cdot E_{\mathrm{bond}}(k).

The absence of a bond between \mathcal{A}_1 and \mathcal{A}_N is the missing link distinguishing chains from rings.
